name: PlanogramComplianceChecker
tagline: Count every shelf position, prove it with a photo and close the gaps – planogram compliance for store teams and area managers.
description: A complete planogram compliance app for Power Apps and Power Pages: schedule bay resets, audit each shelf position (facings, gaps, wrong position, label and price errors, unlisted products) with camera photos, see facings-weighted compliance against standard and end-cap targets, raise and fix corrective actions with owners and due dates, verify independently, and track every store on a bay map heat map, kanban board and reset calendar.
features: Higher target for end caps / promo bays (keywords)
Gap and short-facing replenishment list (CSV + GapListJson)
Camera photo capture, downscaled in the browser
Action required with owner and due date, overdue flags
Independent verification and role rules (merchandiser, store manager, area / VM manager)
Demo mode with a fictional four-store chain
Phone audit sheet with shelf tabs
